session.summary: Two pointers: learned the opposite-ends template on Two Sum II, then solved 3Sum with hints.

attempts.note: Moving the larger end can never miss a pair: every pair it skips is too big.
Skip duplicates after moving both pointers, not before.

questions.text: Why can't the left pointer ever need to move back?

cards.front: Two Sum II (sorted): what is true about every pair outside [l..r]?
cards.back: It has been ruled out: each move discards a row or column of pairs that are all too small or all too big.

artifacts.title: Two Pointers on the (i, j) Grid
